_doc: Ohmar — the terrifying Store Lead and the region's enforcer: an enormous, unnervingly calm man who never raises his voice, and the whole building moves when he breathes. The human face of the management terror that drives every morning's ritual interrogation. Dialogue-only; his 'formal office' manifests as an enemy encounter.
name: Ohmar
title: Store Lead, St. Augustine
samplePhrase: The night shift is the store's face at three in the morning. Right now, that face is yours. It is not good enough.
